correctness.contract: FP16 represented inputs; row-major 16x16x16; binary64 scalar reference; FP32 accumulation; WMMA atol/rtol 0.002; inline PTX FMA atol/rtol 1e-7

limitations: This is a toolkit/runtime and native smoke qualification, not a tuned family benchmark.
CUDA C++ WMMA does not qualify raw MMA lane mapping, CUTLASS, CuTe DSL, or Triton.

profile.collection_scope: controller NCU compact metrics, all target processes, no collection-time kernel-name or launch-count filter; WMMA selected during report analysis
limitations: profiled timing is not used as a performance comparison

sanitizer.qualification: accepted narrowly: zero-error memcheck plus bound native PASS record; raw partial wrapper classification is preserved

timing.comparison: same source and binary on both sides; environment repeatability only, no speedup or promotion claim
timing.measurement: unprofiled CUDA event per launch, smoke only
